answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded escrow, so splitting stake does not erase accountability. When k coordinated identities equivocate on correlated messages, linked evidence makes slashing grow as O(k²), rather than as k independent fines. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier increases the swarm’s capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovered collateral from regaining its prior value; cipher, pigment, and lagoon are merely labels, not protections.
